correctness.rationale: Orthogonal one-coordinate activity/contrast splitting reduces the q-ary Fourier band to Bernoulli slice blocks. Raising and lowering identities establish full harmonic norms and dimensions, an exact generating-function identity fixes every restriction coefficient, and the slice harmonic norm fixes each Gram eigenvalue. Rank and one-equation kernel follow from an independent injectivity proof in the interior range. Three finite full characteristic polynomials agree over the rationals and a genuinely cubic interaction case matches by numerical diagonalization; only the analytic proof covers all parameters.

value.rationale: Fixed-shell sampling of bounded-interaction Fourier signals is a natural reconstruction problem. The theorem explicitly calculates every singular value across arbitrary interior degrees, all q-ary alphabet sizes, gives the entire vanishing ideal in the band via one shell equation, and yields exact quotient conditioning without numerical eigenvalue computation. It is a meaningful all-degree structural classification rather than another small-case computation.
